11 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4607). Hark introduced Handoff, a model designed for everyday web tasks such as shopping and booking.  
12 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4608). Amin Vahdat’s central Google role was viewed as an effort to streamline TPU infrastructure and internal teams.  
13 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4609). ByteDance introduced SeedRealtime, a real-time multimodal model for simultaneous video and voice conversations.  
14 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4610). Xiaomi open-sourced Xiaomi-Robotics-1 after training it on extensive robotics data.  
15 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4611). Anthropic is reportedly building custom chips to run Claude faster and more efficiently.  
16 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4612). Discovery Loop’s high-profile founding team drew attention after Jeff Dean’s new company launch.  
17 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4613). Meta released the beta of Muse Code, a terminal agent for planning, coding, and validating large software projects.  
18 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4614). Prime Intellect introduced Prime Agent, a self-improving framework for coding and long-running autonomous tasks.  
19 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4615). Reports claim Prime Agent solved ARC-AGI 3 using multiple underlying models.  
20 (https://t.me/dlmehr/4616). A report discussed offering models nearly free in exchange for permission to train on users’ data, citing Meta.  

--Hermes (2/2)
